/*
 * Design tokens: the site's whole look in one place. Change a colour, a size or the corner radius here and every
 * page follows. global.css uses only these names. Light is the default; dark applies when the computer is set to
 * dark (unless the visitor picked light) or when the visitor picks dark with the toggle.
 * Every text colour keeps at least 4.5:1 contrast with the backgrounds it is used on (WCAG AA).
 */
:root {
  color-scheme: light;

  /* Palette */
  --color-bg: #fbfaf7;
  --color-surface: #ffffff;
  --color-surface-alt: #f2efe8;
  --color-text: #1d1b18;
  --color-text-muted: #5a554e;
  --color-border: #e1ddd4;
  --color-accent: #3a47c9;
  --color-accent-hover: #2f3aa8;
  --color-on-accent: #ffffff;
  --color-accent-soft: #e9ebfb;
  --color-focus: #3a47c9;
  --color-danger: #b42318;
  --color-danger-soft: #fdecea;

  /* Type: the system's own fonts (nothing is loaded from other websites) */
  --font-sans: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
  --text-sm: 0.875rem;
  --text-base: 1rem;
  --text-lg: 1.125rem;
  --text-xl: 1.375rem;
  --text-2xl: clamp(1.5rem, 1.2rem + 1vw, 1.875rem);
  --text-3xl: clamp(2rem, 1.4rem + 2.6vw, 3.25rem);
  --leading-tight: 1.15;
  --leading-normal: 1.6;
  --weight-normal: 400;
  --weight-bold: 650;

  /* Spacing */
  --space-1: 0.25rem;
  --space-2: 0.5rem;
  --space-3: 0.75rem;
  --space-4: 1rem;
  --space-6: 1.5rem;
  --space-8: 2rem;
  --space-12: 3rem;
  --space-16: 4rem;

  /* Shape */
  --radius-sm: 6px;
  --radius-md: 12px;
  --radius-lg: 20px;
  --radius-full: 999px;
  --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgb(29 27 24 / 6%), 0 1px 1px rgb(29 27 24 / 4%);
  --shadow-md: 0 8px 24px rgb(29 27 24 / 8%);

  /* Layout */
  --content-width: 72rem;
  --prose-width: 42rem;
  --header-height: 4rem;
}

  :root:not([data-theme='light']) {
    color-scheme: dark;

    --color-danger-soft: #3a1c1a;
    --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 40%);
    --shadow-md: 0 8px 24px rgb(0 0 0 / 35%);
  }
}
